title: Lazar recognizes the craft in Billy Meier material

tellings.quote: I think when I described the craft to him and drew it, I think he brought out the Billy Meier stuff.
While hanging out one day, John Lear shows Lazar a tape of Billy Meier, a Swedish ufologist who has been caught in multiple known hoaxes.
tellings.difference: Told by the host rather than Lazar, it calls the material a tape and adds that Meier was caught in hoaxes.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of John Lear bringing out Billy Meier material to show Lazar in Las Vegas around 1989.

as_told.title: Lear shows Lazar Billy Meier tapes

plain: In Las Vegas in 1989, a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at a secret government site in Nevada, is said to have seen the same craft he had worked on in a film made by a known UFO figure. Lazar tells this himself. He says that when he described and drew the craft for an acquaintance named John Lear, Lear brought out material from a man named Billy Meier. Michels tells the same moment in his 2024 documentary about an earlier inventor, saying Lear showed Lazar a tape of Meier while they were hanging out one day. Michels describes Meier as a Swedish ufologist, someone who studies UFOs, who has been caught in several known hoaxes. So the two tellers agree on the meeting, though Lazar speaks of "the Billy Meier stuff" and Michels calls it a tape. The point of the story is that Lazar recognised his craft in footage that existed before he ever spoke about it, which would matter if his own account is to be believed.
